journal.text: We have arrived on an unfamiliar island. Let us find the conditions that bring its plants back to life.

Hypothesis assessment: Public observation 1 reports growth 50, survival false, and energy 40 without water, with no mineral, under amber light at warm temperature. With only this observation, evidence is insufficient to establish a water benefit or dependence on minerals or light. A water-only contrast can test its effect in this setting, but cannot establish whether that effect changes across mineral or light conditions.
